info.title: Add-CustomService
info.description: Saned service repo scaffolding: full CQRS entities, protos, and Add-Feature (Add-CustomService). For the NawrasHR BFF use package Saned.Scaffolder (Add-CustomController).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Saned service — CQRS / protos / full entity scaffold (dotnet tool install -g Saned.Scaffolder.Service):
  Add-CustomService Employee -p "FirstName:string" "LastName:string" "Age:int?" "HireDate:DateTime" "DepartmentId:Guid?"
  Add-CustomService LeaveRequest -p "StartDate:DateTime" "EndDate:DateTime" "Reason:string" "IsApproved:bool?"
  Add-CustomService LeaveRequest -wk true -p "StartDate:DateTime" "EndDate:DateTime" "Reason:string" "IsApproved:bool?"  (SanedSelfServices workflow)
  Add-CustomService -f CreateSkill -s Skill -c "SkillName:string, SkillLevel:int?, Description:string?" -r "SkillId:Guid, SkillName:string, Success:bool"
  Add-CustomService -f GetSkillById -s Skill -q "SkillId:Guid?" -r "SkillName:string, SkillLevel:int, CreatedAt:DateTime"
  Add-CustomService remove -f CreateEmployee -s Employee

NawrasHR BFF (dotnet tool install -g Saned.Scaffolder):
  Add-CustomController -m SanedHR -n EventTest -P true
  Add-CustomController -en GetSkillByUserId -m SanedHR -s Skills -P true -L true
  Add-CustomController -en-mv GetPageExcuseHoursMonthlySummaryReport -m SanedSelfService -s ExcuseHour -to Payroll -ts Any
  Add-CustomController -en-db GetPageExcuseHoursMonthlySummaryReport -m SanedSelfService -s ExcuseHour -to Payroll -ts-new ExcuseHour -P true

Uninstall:
  Add-CustomService remove-tool
  Add-CustomService remove-tool --no-global --local
  Add-CustomService remove-tool --tool-manifest C:\path\to\repo

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Root namespace / service name (e.g. Payroll, HR, Attendance, SelfService). Auto-detected from a .csproj in the output path when omitted.

options.name: --module
options.description: Module / folder name (defaults to entity name + 's', e.g. Employees)

options.name: --output
options.description: Absolute or relative path to the target service root (default: current directory)

options.name: --properties
options.description: Entity fields (repeat or space-separated after -p): e.g. -p "FirstName:string" "LastName:string" "Age:int?"

options.name: --integration-events
options.description: Also generate BuildingBlocks integration-event files

options.name: --bb-path
options.description: Relative path from --output to the BuildingBlocks ServiceContracts root (default: ../../BuildingBlocks/BuildingBlocks.ServiceContracts)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview files that would be created without writing anything

options.name: --no-protos
options.description: Skip generating saned-protos .proto files (C# only)

options.name: --force
options.description: Skip duplicate-name checks (model / result / proto already on disk)

options.name: --workflow
options.description: SanedSelfServices only: inherit WorkflowAudit<Guid>, generate SendToApproval (HTTP + optional gRPC/proto), and validations stub

options.name: --feature
options.description: Feature name in PascalCase, e.g. CreateEmployee, GetEmployeeById

options.name: --service
options.description: Service / entity name in PascalCase, e.g. Employee, Skill

options.name: --command
options.description: Command request properties: "Name:string, Date:DateTime" (mutually exclusive with -q)

options.name: --query
options.description: Query request properties: "Id:Guid" (mutually exclusive with -c)

options.name: --response
options.description: Response properties: "Id:Guid, Success:bool"

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: ENTITY_NAME
arguments.description: PascalCase entity name, e.g. Employee, Department, LeaveRequest

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a named feature added by Add-Feature

options.name: --feature
options.description: Feature name to remove, e.g. CreateEmployee

options.name: --service
options.description: Service name, e.g. Employee

options.name: --output
options.description: Absolute or relative path to the target service root (default: current directory)

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Root namespace / service name (e.g. Payroll, HR, Attendance, SelfService). Auto-detected from a .csproj in the output path when omitted.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview what would be removed without deleting anything

commands.name: remove-tool
commands.description: Uninstall Saned.Scaffolder.Service from this PC (global dotnet tool) and/or from a project manifest (.config/dotnet-tools.json).

options.name: --no-global
options.description: Skip uninstalling the global tool; only use a local manifest if --tool-manifest or --local is set.

options.name: --local
options.description: Uninstall from a local tool manifest (see --tool-manifest; defaults to current directory).

options.name: --tool-manifest
options.description: Folder that contains .config/dotnet-tools.json, or the full path to dotnet-tools.json.
